chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar (may God be pleased with him) narrated that his father quoted Muhammad ibn Ahmad, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ishaq, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Marvan that Aba Abdullah (peace be upon him) said:
Washing the dishes and sweeping the entrance way of the house would speed up the arrival of the daily bread.
ai.seo_question: What domestic actions increase sustenance according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) linking the physical acts of washing dishes and sweeping the courtyard to the acceleration of *rizq* (sustenance). This tradition). This narration underscores the Shia scholarly view that domestic order is not merely hygiene but a spiritual discipline that removes obstacles to divine blessing. It reflects the broader theological principle that material cleanliness facilitates spiritual receptivity to God's provisions.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 2-73 Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar - may God be pleased with him - narrated that his father quoted Muhammad ibn Ahmad, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ishaq, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Marvan that Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) said, “
Washing the dishes and sweeping the entrance way of the house would speed up the arrival of the daily bread.”
